decline_messages.denied: The user declined this on the schedule card; nothing was saved. Tell them in one line what you wanted to schedule, and do not retry it.
decline_messages.timeout: The user did not answer the schedule card in time; nothing was saved. Do not retry it.
decline_messages.other: The schedule card was not approved; nothing was saved. Do not retry it.
decline_messages.stale_create: The schedule card was answered after the first run it showed had passed; nothing was saved. Offer the job again with a later time if it is still wanted.
decline_messages.stale_edit: The change card was answered after the new run time it showed had passed; nothing was saved. Offer the change again with a later time if it is still wanted.

leo_divergence: No answerable surface means the job saves at once, audited (Hermes, Teknium PR #158289); a card is shown only where one can be answered.
